constants.rule: items flow from insetX, a separator before every item but the first; an item fits when width <= room + fitSlack; the first that does not is truncated into the room left if it is a runs item and that room is at least minTruncatedWidth, and nothing after it is drawn. When the trailing group fits whole one separator right of the leading group's start, it sits flush right and the leading group flows into what is left
